shared_elements: vertical stone monolith carved in relief
low/medium relief carving on a rough stone surface
stacked horizontal registers or tiers of imagery
a human or anthropomorphic figure with visible limbs
band of repeated geometric pattern (zigzag/chevron-like or repeated units)
paired symmetrical creatures flanking a central axis
justification: Both are upright stone blocks whose surfaces are organised into stacked horizontal registers, each combining profile animal heads, a frontal human-like figure and a band of repeated geometric units, which gives a loosely comparable vertical narrative scheme. The manner of carving is entirely different, however: A is sparse, shallow and schematic with large empty ground between isolated motifs, while B is a dense, deeply undercut, horror-vacui composition of interlocking ornament on a rounded column.
